state.background: B3i responds to the user's revised policy: accelerate across E=90 MAP-eligible stable rows, accept rough component fixtures for narrow assertion slices, and run one consolidated E2E after each 10 newly migrated eligible rows. B3g's previous 20/20 named-case gate and consolidated E2E passed and remain historical; the new cadence starts 0/10. A fresh independent audit confirmed all ten candidates are MAP-eligible and verified the P42 mappings. B3h's no-safe-candidate conclusion was made under the previous stricter equivalence screen; this proposal applies the revised authorization without weakening retained integration boundaries. Proposed rows: p45-a-cagr-sheet-04 P42-052 horizontal overflow; p45-a-cagr-sheet-05 P42-053/-054 visible chart height >=120px at 375x667; p45-b-mobile-ux-19-ux P42-323/-324 tap-target dimensions; p45-a-a11y-sheet-tab-trap P42-022 actual BottomSheet focus containment; p45-b-tooltip-stack-total-65-e2e-t7-2022 P42-585/-586 actual nominal SpendingBarChart hover tooltip/total (retain -587); p45-a-cpi-legend-scroll P42-263/-264 actual legend click and fixture scroll preservation; p45-b-section-tabs-scroll-47-case01-chromium P42-501/-502 actual SectionTabs click/fixture scroll behavior (retain WebKit); p45-b-range-change-187-e2e-1 P42-463–466 one-year/four-bar local chart contract; p45-b-range-change-200-e2e-2 P42-467–469 doubled-range/eight-bar local chart contract; p45-b-spending-filter-35-e2e-q1 P42-511–514 actual nominal Q1 filter state and bars. Each row remains partial; only mapped assertions that pass Browser Mode count toward 10. Keep production route/dataflow/chart-table/CSV, quarterly production data, URL, page geometry, and WebKit guarantees in E2E. Exclude weak p45-a-cagr-sheet-06 P42-055/-056. If a candidate proves non-actionable, stop and reassess before conditionally substituting p45-b-spending-filter-64-e2e P42-515–518. Keep A=123/E=90/M=1; M counts fully migrated rows only.
acceptanceCriteria: The plan uses the revised 10-newly-migrated-eligible-stable-row cadence and starts at 0/10; B3g's previous completed 20/20 gate is preserved historically and does not count toward this cadence.
The ten rows and exact P42 ranges in the proposal match the independently audited MAP-eligible inventory.
Each Browser Mode case is limited to the mapped local assertion slice and a row counts only after that mapped Browser assertion passes.
Production route/dataflow/chart-table/CSV and quarterly data, URL integration, production geometry, and WebKit guarantees remain Playwright-owned.
Rows stay partial; A=123/E=90/M=1 remains unchanged until a stable row meets the existing full migration definition.
P42-055/-056 is excluded; P42-515–518 is a conditional substitute only after documented non-actionability and a fresh scoped plan reassessment.
This is plan review only; no source/test implementation or test results are claimed.
verification: Independent MAP/P42 audit confirmed all ten candidate rows are eligible and identified the exact mapped assertion groups.
B3g's 20-case gate was completed and one consolidated E2E run passed; B3i proposes a new 0/10 eligible-row cadence.
No tests were run for this plan checkpoint.
knownConstraints: Rough component fixtures are explicitly allowed by the user's revised policy only for the listed local assertions; they do not prove the production route or data integration.
Keep every unlisted P42 assertion and all production integration boundaries in Playwright.
Do not count named Browser Mode tests, assertion totals, or existing B3g cases in place of ten newly migrated eligible stable rows.
M continues to count fully migrated stable rows only; current A/E/M remains 123/90/1.
state.outputRequirement: Assess whether B3i's ten-row assertion-level plan, exact P42 mapping, revised cadence, retained E2E boundaries, and M accounting are valid as defined. Select exactly one criterion and return confidence plus the full probability distribution. If not valid_as_defined, provide a case-specific finding and affected row/assertion, observed evidence or exact neededEvidence, concrete nextAction/proposedFix, and remainingUncertainty. Do not claim implementation/test success or approve scope beyond the listed assertions.

plan.instructions: Select exactly one mutually exclusive criterion for the B3i plan-validity checkpoint.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The ten partial assertion slices and revised eligible-row cadence are sufficiently specified and preserve all stated boundaries.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: The proposed assertion ownership or cadence conflicts with the user's revised policy or the migration requirements.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: Required source/MAP evidence is missing for one or more proposed rows.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The plan lacks necessary fixture or assertion mapping details to judge the proposed partial slices.
criteria.implementation_issue: A concrete source constraint makes one or more proposed component assertions infeasible.
criteria.scope_violation: The plan exceeds the listed P42 slices, weakens production E2E guarantees, or counts partial rows as fully migrated.
criteria.other: A material plan concern does not fit the listed categories.
criteria.indeterminate: The evidence does not support a reliable judgment.
